svg.title: Step 9 mockup 03: the Main screen with live data
svg.text: 03 · The Main screen with live data: Pulse and the six-box Dashboard
Every box from its own feed, pushed within a second. Pulse at the top; the Dashboard below, steady and during a showcase (amendment 2: at most 4 rows a box).
Use case: attendees in the hall read the event at a glance.
Hero: the agenda's next item with its tournament session's game and
cover (tournament, games); the chip says when the semis start (L9,
Right now: bot counts, arrows from 10-minute averages, the 24 h peak
Now playing: counts by game; names only where the zone opts in (U4);
HOT when a game reaches the threshold (L6).
Ticker: still manual (0018); feeds never write it.
Dashboard, steady: standings, Right now, top games, voice rooms, food, photos
During a showcase: the hot game grows to 2 × 2; two boxes stay (amendment 2)
